cause: A foreground actor 3 to 4 world pixels beyond the gate base shared an integer depth bucket with the door's +1 sorting bias, allowing the door to cover the actor at valid foot contact.
fix: Depth-limited workshop doors now sort immediately below the first legal foreground foot position. Collision clipping, closure safety and drawing depth share ActorFootprint.front_contact_y.
pixel_checks: Both door states, both jamb sides at base + 3.01: the rendered body matches an unoccluded reference.
